'''2017 Worlds Drops Nick Reisch DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Drops).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nick Reisch]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Vile Reisch DS 2017 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Drops
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125012710/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
